fields: as a table: cols [field, what it proves, record], rows, fold, fold_noun, seam ("plain"). Optional parts (one per row: num, lot, welder, bead, visual, coupon, sign, cut; default from the field's words). The fold applies on phones only.
best_for: JointTag shows a joint log as a traceability tag hanging from the joint it records: a polypropylene pipe in side view, fused at a double-rolled bead, runs off both page edges, and the tag on its wire carries one form box per log field, each field's number pinned on the part of the joint it describes.
